name: Locate Object
title: find the object on the table
description: Sweep the wrist camera over the work surface to find a named object and its pose, with the arm that will grasp it.

name: Detect Fill Level
title: check how full the glass is
description: Estimate how full a transparent vessel is, from the wrist camera.

name: Verify Surface Clean
title: check whether the surface is clean
description: Score a surface for residue from the head camera. Used as a success detector.

name: Read Label
title: read a printed bottle or package label
description: Read a printed bottle or package label.

name: Detect Spill
title: spot liquid or granular spill on a surface
description: Spot liquid or granular spill on a surface.

name: Grasp Bottle
title: pick up the bottle
description: Close the gripper around an upright bottle and secure it.

name: Grasp Bottle (Lite)
title: pick up the bottle
description: Budget bottle grasp. Same interface, lower success rate, no wrist-camera servoing.

name: Grasp Glass
title: pick up the glass
description: Grasp a stemless glass without tipping it.

name: Grasp Scoop
title: pick up a measuring scoop by the handle
description: Pick up a measuring scoop by the handle.

name: Grasp Shaker
title: grasp a cocktail shaker around its body
description: Grasp a cocktail shaker around its body.

name: Grasp Object
title: pick up the object
description: Pick up a rigid, hand-sized loose item by its body or handle -- fruit, a lid, a utensil, a brush, a bucket, a box.

name: Grasp Cloth
title: pick up the cloth
description: Pick up a folded cloth or sponge from a flat surface.

name: Release Object
title: let go of it there
description: Open the gripper wherever the held object was moved to, and retract. Over a vessel this drops the object in; over the table it sets it down.

name: Bimanual Handover
title: pass a held object from one arm to the other
description: Pass a held object from one arm to the other. Requires dual-arm structure.

name: Twist Cap
title: unscrew and remove a bottle cap while the bottle is held
description: Unscrew and remove a bottle cap while the bottle is held.

name: Press Dispenser
title: press down on a pump dispenser
description: Press down on a pump dispenser.

name: Open Drawer
title: hook a drawer handle and pull it open
description: Hook a drawer handle and pull it open.

name: Close Drawer
title: push a drawer closed
description: Push a drawer closed.

name: Move To Location
title: carry it over to the target
description: Carry the held object to a named place and hold it there -- over a vessel, above a glass, back onto the table.

name: Place On Coaster
title: put the glass down on the coaster
description: Set a held glass down on the coaster, upright and centred.
prompt: put the glass down on the coaster

name: Place In Bin
title: put it in the bin
description: Drop a held object into a bin.

name: Return To Shelf
title: return a bottle to its slot on the shelf
description: Return a bottle to its slot on the shelf.

name: Load Tray
title: place an object onto a serving tray
description: Place an object onto a serving tray.

name: Pour Into
title: pour it into the target
description: Tilt the held bottle or vessel, already moved over the target, pour a target amount and come back upright.
prompt: pour from the bottle into the glass

name: Measured Pour
title: pour a specified volume using closed-loop fill-level feedback
description: Pour a specified volume using closed-loop fill-level feedback.

name: Scoop And Pour
title: empty a filled scoop into the vessel it was moved over
description: Empty a filled scoop into the vessel it was moved over.

name: Top Up
title: add liquid until a target fill level is reached
description: Add liquid until a target fill level is reached.

name: Stir
title: stir the drink in the glass
description: Insert a stirrer and run a circular stirring motion in the glass.
prompt: stir the drink in the glass

name: Shake Shaker
title: agitate a sealed shaker vertically for a set duration
description: Agitate a sealed shaker vertically for a set duration.

name: Swirl Glass
title: rotate a held glass to mix contents without a stirrer
description: Rotate a held glass to mix contents without a stirrer.

name: Run Blender
title: press and hold a countertop blender's start button until the contents are smooth
description: Press and hold a countertop blender's start button until the contents are smooth.

name: Seal Shaker
title: press the lid onto a shaker
description: Press the lid onto a shaker.

name: Wipe Surface
title: wipe the table clean
description: Run overlapping wiping strokes across a bounded flat area.

name: Wipe Spill
title: wipe up the spill
description: Wipe a localised spill, working inward from the edges.

name: Polish Glass
title: rotate a glass against a cloth to remove streaks
description: Rotate a glass against a cloth to remove streaks. Bimanual.

name: Rinse Vessel
title: hold a vessel under a tap and rinse
description: Hold a vessel under a tap and rinse.

name: Clear Table
title: move every loose object on the table into a bin or tray
description: Move every loose object on the table into a bin or tray.

name: Stack Glasses
title: nest a glass into a stack
description: Nest a glass into a stack.

name: Garnish
title: place a fruit slice or similar garnish on the glass rim
description: Place a fruit slice or similar garnish on the glass rim.

name: Add Straw
title: drop a straw into a filled glass
description: Drop a straw into a filled glass.

name: Add Umbrella
title: place a cocktail umbrella in a filled glass
description: Place a cocktail umbrella in a filled glass.

name: Serve To Guest
title: present the finished drink to a person and wait for them to take it
description: Present the finished drink to a person and wait for them to take it.

name: Slide Coaster
title: slide a coaster into position
description: Slide a coaster into position.

name: Fold Towel
title: fold a rectangular towel in halves
description: Fold a rectangular towel in halves.

name: Sort Cutlery
title: sort mixed cutlery into compartments
description: Sort mixed cutlery into compartments.

name: Load Dishwasher
title: place crockery into a dishwasher rack
description: Place crockery into a dishwasher rack.

name: Water Plant
title: pour a measured amount into a plant pot
description: Pour a measured amount into a plant pot.

name: Wipe Window
title: wipe a vertical glass surface
description: Wipe a vertical glass surface.

name: Pick Up From Floor
title: pick an object off the floor
description: Pick an object off the floor. Requires torso or mobile base.

name: Open Fridge
title: pull a fridge door open by the handle
description: Pull a fridge door open by the handle.

name: Place In Fridge
title: put a held item onto a fridge shelf
description: Put a held item onto a fridge shelf.

name: Sweep Crumbs
title: brush crumbs from a surface into a dustpan
description: Brush crumbs from a surface into a dustpan.

name: Align Chair
title: push a chair flush to the table edge
description: Push a chair flush to the table edge.

name: Hang Cloth
title: drape a cloth over a rail
description: Drape a cloth over a rail.

name: Close Fridge
title: push the fridge door shut
description: Push the fridge door shut.

name: Wipe Handle
title: wipe a cylindrical handle or rail
description: Wipe a cylindrical handle or rail.

name: Pour Cereal
title: pour granular food into a bowl
description: Pour granular food into a bowl.

name: Set A Place
title: lay out a plate, cutlery and glass for one person
description: Lay out a plate, cutlery and glass for one person.

name: Collect Bottles
title: gather loose bottles into a crate
description: Gather loose bottles into a crate.
